label: SYNTHETIC / 合成示例 — authored universal and bounded claims

claims.statement: PEO always reduces mass loss in every Aster-17 subgroup and is state of the art on all datasets.

evidence.quote: Thick coupons were 2.0 mm and thin coupons were 0.8 mm; each arm contained eight coupons of each thickness.
In the thin stratum, mean mass loss was 8.7 g/m^2 with PEO and 7.9 g/m^2 without coating, reversing the pooled direction.
The study was not designed to test service life, other alloys, field environments, or rankings against other coating methods.

counterexamples.reason: The in-scope 0.8 mm subgroup has higher mass loss with PEO, defeating 'always' and 'every subgroup'; the pooled result must not erase this exception.

claims.bounded_restatement: In this single fictional batch of cast Aster-17 coupons exposed to 5% NaCl salt spray for 48 h at 35 °C, PEO lowered pooled mean mass loss versus no coating, but the 0.8 mm thin subgroup reversed direction; service-life and state-of-the-art claims are not reported.

claims.statement: For the tested fictional cast Aster-17 coupons under the specified 48 h salt spray, pooled and thick-stratum mean mass loss favored PEO over no coating, while the thin stratum did not.

R-THIN.reason: This aggregate bounded synthesis deliberately includes the separately identified contrary thin-stratum record so the pooled and opposite subgroup directions remain distinct.

claims.statement: Service life, other alloys, field environments, and comparative state-of-the-art ranking are not reported.
